claims.statement: A rumour said a match between Tom Kelly and Tom Allen was being arranged, but no definite steps had been taken.
claims.excerpt: rumor that arrangements would soon be made fer
places: Sixth and Market streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: Several friends of Tom Kelly offered to back him with $500 or more to fight Tom Allen, if Allen could be brought down to Kelly's weight.
claims.excerpt: Kelly would be backed to any amount provided the arrangements could be made,

quotes.speaker: an unnamed friend of Tom Kelly
quotes.text: Tt he id ges Alien cewn to his weight he weuld fignt him in a minute.
quotes.topic: Allen coming down to Kelly's weight

notes: No match was agreed, so no fight entry. The quote is OCR-garbled. The speaker is a friend of Kelly, not named. The benefit was on Friday, November 29, 1872. The hint's $1,000 figure is not legible in the text (only '$1' shows), so it is not used.
